final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.instownpct AS o, t.ordertypedist AS d FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT d, AVG(o) AS ga FROM j GROUP BY d), ov AS (SELECT AVG(o) AS oa FROM j) SELECT AVG(j.o) AS avg_own, AVG(j.o / g.ga) AS avg_ratio_to_group, AVG(j.o - ov.oa) AS avg_excess FROM j JOIN g ON j.d = g.d CROSS JOIN ov WHERE j.o > ov.oa
